COR-TRY-23-002, Write-off of Uncollectible Accounts for the Year Ended December 31, 2022
notes: Craig Dyer Commissioner of Corporate Services and Chief Financial Officer provided committee with an annual update on the Write-off of Uncollectible Accounts totalling over $169,000. C. Dyer noted that the write-off accounts were for any inidividual accounts in excess of $10,000 and that below this level staff have delegated authority through regional by-law to write off as required. C.Dyer noted that the summary of write offs, a majority relate to housing and one account to general receivables. $169,000 is a small amount of the total billed over the course of the year.

items.title: HRC-TOR-23-001, Region of Waterloo Sustaining a Strong Workforce (Staff Presentation)
notes:
Kim Bellissimo, Commissioner of Human Resources and Citizen Service provided a presentation, which included an overview of the current opportunities and challenges for sustaining a strong workforce, such as high inflation and a historically low unemployment rate. K. Bellissimo also provided an overview of how the Region is responding to talent attraction and retention concerns, noting that staff are focused on building a comprehensive talent management plan, which prioritizes diversity, equity and inclusion. 

A copy of the presentation is attached to the minutes. The report was received for information.

In response to the Committee, K. Bellissimo confirmed that a third of the Region’s current workforce engages in a hybrid work model, where staff are able to work from home and the office, and that this flexibility is a talent attraction tool. K. Bellissimo also clarified that the expectation is for staff to work from a Regional office location for a minimum of two days a week, irrespective of where the staff member may choose to reside.

K. Williams joined the meeting at 2:35 p.m.

K. Redman joined the meeting at 2:36 p.m.
